cv_source: biohub_tracking.eval.cv (SOT-2761 leak-free 4-family holdout, SOT-2817 full-metric re-anchor)
rationale: Objective was to recover the metric's abandoned 0.1*division_jaccard term. NO per-family-edge-non-regressing variant recovers any division TP: every 'promotable' variant has division_jaccard=0.0 (the axis objective is NOT met).

Variants that DO recover a real division TP (div_j up to 0.0909, best combined +0.0084) all REGRESS the sibling dense family 6bba_05b6850b (adj 0.5700->0.5685) because that family has 0 GT divisions, so every added second-daughter fork there is a pure division/edge FP. This is the SAME failure mode SOT-2762 was rejected for, now reproduced through the non-destructive overlay mechanism (new evidence: even without touching the LAP linking assignment, added 2nd-daughter edges spray FP on the dense zero-division family).

The only non-regressing gain (md=3.0 variants, +0.0004 combined) comes purely from incidental EDGE-TP recovery (6bba_05b6850b edge tp 651->652) with division_jaccard=0.0 (division term still forfeited, plus 1 division FP). It does not fulfil the axis objective and is a FAMILY-MIX-SENSITIVE micro hair-gain (micro<->lineage-macro gap 0.0565 > 0.05 tol; representativeness_report family_mix_sensitive=True), i.e. exactly the dominant-lineage hair-gain the SOT-2817 guard flags as insufficient evidence. Promoting a +0.06%% family-mix-sensitive micro delta risks repeating the SOT-2816 CV-up / LB-down hazard.

Therefore: keep the overlay implemented but default-OFF; do not update champion/config.json or registry; champion CV stays 0.6649 byte-for-byte (screen baseline reproduced it exactly with the new code path).
byte_identity_off: screen baseline (champion config, overlay absent -> division_overlay=None) reproduced micro_adj=0.6649 / score=0.6649 exactly with the new champion.py/link.py code path; pytest 121 passed incl. test_division_overlay off-is-no-op.
